packs.title: Pack 1: Starter Core & Numbers (初始免費 15 字)

cards.mnemonic: Think of Adam and Eve, the very first human beings. 'Eve' without 've' (Ee-) sounds like 'one'.

cards.sound: Sounds like the first part of 'error' (retroflex).
cards.mnemonic: An 'error' often occurs at a fork in the road when faced with two paths.
A sandwich relies on a 'tri-layer' (three) foundation.

cards.sound: Similar to the ending of 'force' (stressed hiss).
cards.mnemonic: There are four fundamental forces in physics.
If your pursuit (woo) is successful, give your friends a High Five!
Six (666) means things are going smoothly in China—you are a pro / a Leo!
There are Seven wonders to sightsee with your wife (妻 tsee).
8 is the symbol of fortune. Imagine a bar full of lucky people celebrating.
Nine means Eternity/Long-lasting. May Uncle Joe have a long life!

cards.sound: Sounds like the end of 'fish' (rising tone).
cards.mnemonic: The Roman 'X' (10) is like a fish out of water. Catch the Fi-SH!
These days, you need a hundred-dollar bill just to buy the basics.
Spend a thousand dollars to sightsee an Egyptian pyramid.
He won ten thousand dollars!
Imagine kneeling down while greeting you.
Nee3 haw3 (你好) = Knee + how = Hello (Literally: You good).

packs.title: Pack 2: Everyday Greetings & Core Words (⭐ 五星好評解鎖 15 字)

cards.sound: Memorize tone through woo3 (five) and nee3 (you).
cards.mnemonic: In archaic Chinese, 'woo3 (吾)' represented 'I' or 'myself'.
May -> Mayflower -> The United States (may3 gooer2) -> Beautiful.
No Mayflower, no United States. Digging a pool in the country to raise a goose.
Rap rhythm: 'woo3, Leeoh4 (5,6); haw3, hooie4 (good, bad)'.
Let's sing when we make a polite request!
'Seer4 seer' (Thank you) and 'See ya' always go hand in hand.
In ancient China, friends played music ('Xylophone') when saying goodbye.
When someone thanks you with a curtsy, say 'Boo Curtsy' (Don't do this curtsy).
Dwayne is right (dooay4); Don't get angry (boo2 tsee4); I am sorry.
Dwayne's wife would forgive him if they could see the lagoon.
The morning movement of yawning: your jaw sang! (Dsaw3 (r)sang4 haw3 = Good morning).
Ah, gee, our big family eats a dozen eggs in a jar every morning!
Happy kids are quite lovely! (Seen neean2 kooie4 Ler4 = Happy New Year).

cards.sound: Similar to 'far try' or 'far it's I'.
cards.mnemonic: Have a bold 'far try' to make a fortune! (Ger-oong see3 fah tsie2).

cards.sound: Keep 'r' tongue of 'rain' + weak form of 'then'.
cards.mnemonic: Also similar to the ending of 'human vision'.

packs.title: Pack 3: Travel, Family & Life (📤 推薦好友解鎖 15 字)

cards.mnemonic: While traveling, say 'Hi' (Salut) to you!
Dow, you are our tour guide!
Associate a nice girl with traveling and saying 'Hi' (hie2).
Son represents the Sun, and tone 11 represents sunbeams.
The crowd, including my elder sister, jeered at me.
If you don't know WHERE you are, things are getting GNARLY!
A kawaii girl asked, 'May I (ker3 yee3)...?'
Once I buy it, it's all my own!
Heavy fruits hang and sway across the countryside fields.
I want to see Young's beer. Yours (nee3 der = need) is what you want (yaw4).
Cow though it is, it is still used for barbecue!
The truth lies in where you come from.
New though the cook is, the beef is delicious!
The character 朋 pairs two moons—symbolizing enduring friendship.
There are many bamboos in the zoo. Say 'Hi' to the sea!
